description: This Java class defines a custom precondition check for Liquibase database migrations within the OpenMRS project. It verifies that all free text drug order dose units and frequencies are mapped to concepts prior to upgrading to version 1.10, to ensure data consistency and proper functioning after the upgrade.

classes.name: CheckDrugOrderUnitAndFrequencyTextNotMappedToConcepts
classes.description: A class implementing a Liquibase CustomPrecondition to ensure that free text drug order dose units and frequencies are mapped to concepts before upgrading to version 1.10.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs the validation by querying drug order units and frequencies, then throws exceptions if unmapped free text entries are found.

methods.name: getUnMappedText
methods.description: Returns a set of text entries that are not blank and not mapped to concepts.
